title: lazy-dequant-pass-through-scale-fusion-and-kv-prefix-preservation
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: we observed regressive throughput on long-prefix streaming workloads when enabling dequant fusion across INT8/FP8 execution paths. Root cause: eager dequantization in the fused kernel invalidated lightweight KV prefix invariants used by continuous-batcher coalescing and made the prefix alignment patchy across microbatches. This PR introduces a 'lazy dequant pass-through' fusion that delays element-wise dequant until the last possible point while exposing a small metadata header (scale_hint) that allows the kvcache layer to preserve prefix alignment and reuse. The approach reduces memory churn and makes batching/coalescing behave deterministically across mixed-precision kernels.

Changes (high level):
- Introduces runtime/exec/lazy_dequant_pass.cc and lazy_dequant_pass.h: implements pass-through fusion and a small fast-path that emits scale_hint instead of performing immediate dequant.
- Adds kvcache/prefix_preserver.{h,cc}: attaches scale_hint to prefix entries and ensures equality checks for prefix reuse include scale_hint compatibility.
- Scheduler updates in scheduler/continuous_batcher.cc: batcher now accounts for deferred dequant semantics when coalescing microbatches (maintains per-batch scale_hint histogram to prefer same-scale merges).
- Kernel changes in kernels/quant_fusion_x86.{cpp,h}: new helper to finalize dequant during kernel tail processing; keeps hot path vectorized.
- Tests and benchmarks: tests/quant/bench_lazy_dequant.py (new microbench harness) and tests/kv/prefix_preservation_test.cc.
- Docs: docs/design/quant-dequant-lazy.md describing the invariants and safety checks.

Design notes and constraints:
- The lazy pass exposes scale_hint which is a 16-bit quantized summary (per-head mean scale and exponent) — intentionally compact to avoid inflating KV storage. The pass is conservative: if a head's scale_hint differs across prefixes we avoid reuse; this preserves correctness and minimizes risk to model outputs.
- The fusion keeps the existing dequant path intact as a fallback; we only take the lazy path for kernels that declare "supports_lazy_dequant" in their metadata.
- Continuous-batcher changes include a lightweight heuristic to prefer coalescing microbatches with identical scale_hint histograms; when the histogram differs above a threshold we fall back to prior behavior.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc and perf plan (ENG-4512) 
- [x] Unit tests for kvcache invariants 
- [x] Microbench harness and CI perf job added 
- [x] Backwards-compatible kernel fallback 
- [x] Manual QA on representative models (Llama2-13B INT8, internal FP8 resnet)

Performance summary (internal microbench, 8xA100, sequence length 2048, batch=1->4 streaming):
- End-to-end tail latency median: -7.8% for INT8 fused kernels, -6.5% for FP8 path.
- Throughput (tokens/s) improvement: +18% on mixed-precision long-prefix streaming when lazy-pass is enabled and batcher coalescing is active.
- KV cache memory overhead: +0.6% due to scale_hint header.

Safety and compatibility:
- No model quality regressions observed on our RTT eval set (prompt deltas < 0.2% BLEU-like metric).
- The change is opt-in per-kernel; non-upgraded kernels fall back to the old eager dequant path.

How to test locally: 
1) run pytest tests/kv/prefix_preservation_test.cc (gtest)
2) python3 tests/quant/bench_lazy_dequant.py --model llama2-13b --dtype int8 --profile
3) Use bench/compare.sh to compare old/master vs branch performance (script included).

Related work: this complements earlier dequant-routing PRs (see ENG-4300 and the kernel coalescer experiments) and specifically targets regression observed in long-prefix streaming incident INT-2025-07.

Notes for reviewers: please focus on correctness of prefix_preserver equality checks and scheduler compatibility with existing autoscaling heuristics. There is a small API surface on KV entries (scale_hint) and we should validate that telemetry and retention policies are unaffected.

review_comments: Diego Salazar (2025-09-10): Nice approach. Two requests: (1) ensure the scale_hint is deterministic across different compile flags, (2) add a short-circuit path in kvcache lookup to avoid histogram buildup. See inline note in prefix_preserver.cc.
Asha Menon (2025-09-11): Addressed both: added deterministic serialization for scale_hint and short-circuit in lookup if exact match found. PTAL.
Jon Clark (2025-09-12): Found a race in continuous_batcher when a batch is promoted while another thread merges; added suggestion to hold batcher-level mutex during histogram merge.
merge_result: Merged by Maya Liu on 2025-09-18 via squash merge. Merge commit: 7a2b4c3 (squash of 4 commits). Backported a small compatibility shim to release/2025-09 in a follow-up hotfix.
release_notes: Improved quantized inference performance: lazy dequant fusion reduces streaming tail latency and boosts throughput on long-prefix workloads. Adds a compact scale_hint header to KV entries to enable safer prefix reuse. Opt-in per-kernel; no breaking changes expected.
